title: South Korean cement demand to stay below 40Mt/yr in 2027
content:
South Korea: Domestic cement demand in South Korea will remain below 40Mt/yr in 2027, with the Korea Cement Association forecasting 39.7Mt/yr amid a construction downturn. Demand fell from 50.2Mt/yr in 2023 to 38.3Mt/yr in 2025, with shipments forecast at 38.7Mt/yr in 2026.
